## Transportation of Dangerous Goods Regulations {#transportation-of-dangerous-goods-regulations .Title-of-Act}

[SOR]{.abbr title="Statutory Orders and Regulations"}/2001-286
:::

[TRANSPORTATION OF DANGEROUS GOODS ACT, 1992](/eng/acts/T-19.01)

Registration 2001-08-01

Transportation of Dangerous Goods Regulations

P.C. 2001-1366 2001-08-01
::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: section
::: {.section .order}
Whereas, pursuant to 30(1) of the [Transportation of Dangerous Goods
Act, 1992](/eng/acts/T-19.01)[[Footnote
]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#fn_SOR_2001_286_e_hq_20407){#fn_SOR_2001_286_e_hq_20407-ID0EFBBA},
a copy of the proposed [Transportation of Dangerous Goods
Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2001-286), substantially in the
annexed form, was published in the [Canada
Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/), Part I, on August 7, 1999 and a
reasonable opportunity was afforded to interested persons to make
representations to the Minister with respect to the proposed
Regulations;

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#fn_SOR_2001_286_e_hq_20407-ID0EFBBA){#fn_SOR_2001_286_e_hq_20407}S.C.
  1992, c. 34
  :::

Therefore, His Excellency the Governor General in Council, on the
recommendation of the Minister of Transport, pursuant to section 27 of
the [Transportation of Dangerous Goods Act,
1992](/eng/acts/T-19.01)[[Footnote
]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#fn_SOR_2001_286_e_hq_20407){#fn_SOR_2001_286_e_hq_20407-ID0EDAAA},
makes the annexed [Transportation of Dangerous Goods
Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2001-286).
:::

### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1227371 .Subheading}

- **[[1.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.3
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2020-23, s.
  1\]]{.Repealed}

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In these Regulations,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} "must" is imperative and "may" is permissive;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the words "on", "in" or "by" are synonymous when
    they are associated with the defined terms [[road
    vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[railway
    vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[vessel]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} or
    [[aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef};

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} pressure expressed in kPa is gauge pressure unless
    designated as absolute pressure, except for vapour pressure, which
    is always absolute pressure;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} shipping names listed in Schedule 1 may be

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} written in the singular or plural,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} written in upper or lower case letters, except
      that when the shipping name is followed by the descriptive text
      associated with the shipping name the descriptive text must be in
      lower case letters and the shipping name must be in upper case
      letters (capitals),

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in English only, put in a different word order
      as long as the full shipping name is used and the word order is a
      commonly used one,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} for solutions and mixtures, followed by the word
      "SOLUTION" or "MIXTURE", as appropriate, and may include the
      concentration of the solution or mixture, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} for waste, preceded or followed by the word
      "WASTE" or "[DÉCHET]{.otherLang lang="fr"}";

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a symbol set out in column 1 of the following table
    represents the corresponding unit of measure set out in column 2:

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} when the word "placard" is used, it refers to a
    specific placard illustrated in the Appendix to Part 4 (Dangerous
    Goods Safety Marks), but when a placard is required or permitted to
    be displayed, the singular includes the plural and it means the
    appropriate number of that placard required by Part 4;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the word "or" is used in the inclusive sense unless
    the associated text clearly indicates otherwise;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} when a shipping document or a document is required,
    the requirement refers to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the original shipping document or original
      document, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a copy of the shipping document or document;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} when it is necessary to convert between number of
    articles and net explosives quantity, one kilogram net explosives
    quantity must be counted as 100 articles and each 100 articles must
    be counted as one kilogram net explosives quantity;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} when dangerous goods are in a means of containment,
    it is the minimum required means of containment if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} all other means of containment containing it are
      removed, the means of containment and the dangerous goods it
      contains would be in compliance with the Act and these Regulations
      for the purposes of offering for transport, handling or transport
      of dangerous goods, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} all other means of containment containing it and
      the means of containment itself are removed, some of the dangerous
      goods it contains would no longer be in a means of containment
      that is in compliance with the Act and these Regulations for the
      purposes of offering for transport, handling or transport of
      dangerous goods;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} when the words "means of containment" are used,
    they refer to the minimum required means of containment unless the
    associated text clearly indicates otherwise; and

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} the words "gross mass of all dangerous goods" in
    sections 1.15, 1.16, 1.21 and 1.22 refer to dangerous goods that
    require shipping documents or that are intended to be transported in
    accordance with those sections.

### [Definitions --- Safety Standards and Safety Requirement Documents]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1227404 .Subheading}

**[[1.3.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.3.1 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in these Regulations.

[[ASTM D 4359]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ASTM D 4359]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the ASTM D 4359-90,
    Standard Test Method for Determining Whether a Material Is a Liquid
    or a Solid, July 1990, published by the American Society for Testing
    and Materials (ASTM). ([ASTM D 4359]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ASTM F 852]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ASTM F 852]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the ASTM F 852-86, Standard
    Specification for Portable Gasoline Containers for Consumer Use,
    June 1986, published by the American Society for Testing and
    Materials (ASTM). ([ASTM F 852]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CGA P-20]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CGA P-20]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CGA P-20 --- 2009,
    Standard for Classification of Toxic Gas Mixtures, Fourth Edition,
    2009, published by the Compressed Gas Association, Inc. (CGA). ([CGA
    P-20]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CGSB-32.301]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CGSB-32.301]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the National Standard of
    Canada CAN/CGSB-32.301-M87, Canola Meal, April 1987, published by

    (CGSB). ([CGSB-32.301]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CGSB-43.123]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

[[CGSB-43.125]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

[[CGSB-43.126]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

    Method for Skin Corrosion, July 19, 2006, published by the
    Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development.
    (OECD) ([Ligne directrice de l'OCDE 435]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[Supplement to the ICAO Technical Instructions]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Supplement to the ICAO Technical
    Instructions]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Supplement to the
    Technical Instructions for the Safe Transport of Dangerous Goods by
    Air, published by the International Civil Aviation Organization
    (ICAO), as amended from time to time. ([Supplément aux Instructions
    techniques de l'OACI]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[TP 14850]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[TP 14850]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Transport Canada Standard
    TP 14850 E, Small Containers for Transport of Dangerous Goods,
    Classes 3, 4, 5, 6.1, 8, and 9, a Transport Canada Standard, 2^nd^
    Edition, October 2010, published by the Department of
    Transport. ([TP 14850]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[TP 14877]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[TP 14877]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Transport Canada Standard
    TP 14877E, Containers for Transport of Dangerous Goods by Rail, a
    Transport Canada Standard, January 2018, published by the Department
    of Transport. ([TP 14877]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ULC Standard S504]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ULC Standard S504]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the National
    Standard of Canada CAN/ULC-S504-02, Standard for Dry Chemical Fire
    Extinguishers, Second Edition, August 14, 2002, as amended January
    2007, August 2007 and April 2009, published by Underwriters'
    Laboratories of Canada. ([ULC-S504]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ULC Standard S507]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ULC Standard S507]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the National
    Standard of Canada CAN/ULC-S507-05, Standard for Water Fire
    Extinguishers, Fourth Edition, February 28, 2005, as amended January
    2007, published by Underwriters' Laboratories of
    Canada. ([ULC-S507]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ULC Standard S512]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ULC Standard S512]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the National
    Standard of Canada CAN/ULC-S512-M87, Standard for Halogenated Agent
    Hand and Wheeled Fire Extinguishers, April 1987, as amended March
    1989, March 1990, April 1993, September 1996, September 1997 and
    April 1999, and reaffirmed February 2007, published by Underwriters'
    Laboratories of Canada. ([ULC-S512]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ULC Standard S554]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ULC Standard S554]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the National
    Standard of Canada CAN/ULC-S554-05, Standard for Water Based Agent
    Fire Extinguishers, Second Edition, February 28, 2005, and
    reaffirmed 2010, published by Underwriters' Laboratories of
    Canada. ([ULC-S554]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[UN Recommendations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[UN Recommendations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Recommendations
    on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, published by the United Nations
    (UN), as amended from time to time. ([Recommandations de
    l'ONU]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

### [Transitional Period]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1227447 .Subheading}

**[[1.3.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.3.2 .sectionLabel}** Despite section
1.3.1, if any of the following documents is amended after the coming
into force of this section, instead of the current version of the
document, the previous version of the document may be complied with for
a period of six months after the day on which the current version is
published:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} CGSB-43.123;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} CGSB-43.125;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} CGSB-43.126;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} CGSB-43.146;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} CGSB-43.151;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} CSA B339;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} CSA B340;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} CSA B341;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} CSA B342;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} CSA B620;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} CSA B621;

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} CSA B622;

- [(m)]{.lawlabel} CSA B625; and

- [(n)]{.lawlabel} CSA B626.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2017-137, s. 4
:::

### [Interpretation of TP 14877]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1227465 .Subheading}

**[[1.3.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.3.3 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
TP 14877, "the coming into force of this Standard" and "the date this
standard comes into force" must be read as "the coming into force of
section 1.3.3 of the Regulations".

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2019-75, s.  3
:::

### [Definitions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1227469 .Subheading}

**[[1.4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.4 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in these Regulations.

[[Act]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Act]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the [Transportation of Dangerous
    Goods Act, 1992](/eng/acts/T-19.01). ([Loi]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[adsorbed gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[adsorbed gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a gas that when packaged
    for transport is adsorbed onto a solid porous material resulting in
    an internal receptacle pressure of less than 101.3 kPa at 20°C and
    less than 300 kPa at 50°C. ([gaz adsorbé]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[aerosol container]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[aerosol container]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an article
    consisting of any non-refillable means of containment that contains
    a substance under pressure and that is fitted with a self-closing
    device that allows the contents to be ejected as

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} solid or liquid particles in suspension in a gas;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a foam, paste or powder; or

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a liquid or gas. ([bombe
      aérosol]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any machine capable of
    deriving support in the atmosphere from reactions of the air, other
    than a machine designed to derive support in the atmosphere from
    reactions against the earth's surface of air expelled from the
    machine, and includes a rocket. ([aéronef]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[biological product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[biological product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a product that is
    derived from living organisms and that is used to prevent, treat or
    diagnose disease in humans or animals or for development, experiment
    or investigation purposes and includes finished or unfinished
    products, live vaccines or attenuated live vaccines. ([produit
    biologique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CANUTEC]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CANUTEC]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Canadian Transport
    Emergency Centre of the Department of
    Transport. ([CANUTEC]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[capacity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[capacity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, for a means of containment
    used to contain

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a liquid or a gas, the maximum volume of water,
      normally expressed in litres, that the means of containment can
      hold at 15°C and at an absolute pressure of 101.325 kPa; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} dangerous goods other than a liquid or a gas, the
      maximum volume, normally expressed in cubic metres, that the means
      of containment can hold. ([capacité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[cargo aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[cargo aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an aircraft, other than
    a passenger carrying aircraft, that is carrying goods or
    property. ([aéronef cargo]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[carrier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[carrier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who, whether or not
    for hire or reward, has possession of dangerous goods while they are
    in transport. ([transporteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Category A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Category A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an infectious substance
    that is transported in a form such that, when it is released outside
    of its means of containment and there is physical contact with
    humans or animals, it is capable of causing permanent disability or
    life-threatening or fatal disease to humans or animals. ([catégorie
    A]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Category B]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Category B]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an infectious substance
    that does not meet the criteria for inclusion in Category
    A. ([catégorie B]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[certification safety mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[certification safety mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2023-155, s. 4\]]{.Repealed}

[[class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, when the word "class" is
    followed by

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} one digit, the class of dangerous goods listed in
      the schedule to the Act; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} two digits separated by a point, the class of
      dangerous goods listed in the schedule to the Act and its
      division. ([classe]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[classification]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[classification]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, for dangerous goods,
    as applicable, the shipping name, the primary class, the
    compatibility group, the subsidiary class, the UN number, the
    packing group, and the infectious substance
    category. ([classification]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[compatibility group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[compatibility group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means one of the 13
    groups of explosives described in Appendix 2 of Part 2
    (Classification). ([groupe de compatibilité]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[consignment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[consignment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a quantity of dangerous
    goods transported at the same time in one or more means of
    containment from one consignor at one location to one consignee at
    another location. ([envoi]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[consignor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[consignor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person in Canada who

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is named in a shipping document as the consignor;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} imports or who will import dangerous goods into
      Canada; or

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if paragraphs (a) and (b) do not apply, has
      possession of dangerous goods immediately before they are in
      transport. ([expéditeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[consolidation bin]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[consolidation bin]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a bin that is used
    in a road vehicle

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to secure one or more small means of containment
      so that, under normal conditions of transport, they will not shift
      in a way that might compromise their integrity; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to allow small means of containment to be added
      or removed during transport. ([conteneur de
      groupage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[culture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[culture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the result of a process by
    which pathogens in a specimen are intentionally propagated. This
    definition does not include specimens taken from a human or animal
    patient and that are intended to be processed in a
    laboratory. ([culture]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[cylinder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[cylinder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a small means of containment,
    other than an aerosol container, that is cylindrical or spherical in
    shape and that is capable of withstanding an internal absolute
    pressure of 275 kPa. ([bouteille à gaz]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[dangerous goods safety mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[dangerous goods safety mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2023-155, s. 4\]]{.Repealed}

[[Director General]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Director General]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2023-155, s. 4\]]{.Repealed}

[[drum]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[drum]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a flat-ended or convex-ended
    cylindrical means of containment made of metal, fibreboard, plastic
    or other similar material, with a maximum capacity of 450 L, or for
    a drum made of plywood, a maximum capacity of 250 L. This definition
    includes means of containment of other shapes such as pail-shaped or
    round with a tapered neck, but does not include a wood barrel or
    jerrican (that is, a means of containment of rectangular or
    polygonal cross-section). ([fût]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[dust]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[dust]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a mixture of solid particles and
    air in which 90% or more of the solid particles have a diameter less
    than or equal to 10 µm. ([poussière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[emergency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[emergency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an immediate danger to
    public safety

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} requiring the use of dangerous goods to avert or
      mitigate the danger; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} arising directly or indirectly from dangerous
      goods. ([urgence]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[employer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[employer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} employs one or more individuals; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provides the services of one or more individuals
      and from whom the individuals receive their
      remuneration. ([employeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ERAP]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ERAP]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an emergency response assistance
    plan. ([PIU]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[farmer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[farmer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person engaged in farming in
    Canada for commercial purposes. ([agriculteur]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[farming]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[farming]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the production of field-grown
    crops, cultivated and uncultivated and horticultural crops, the
    raising of livestock, poultry and fur-bearing animals, the
    production of eggs, milk, honey, maple syrup, tobacco, fibre and
    fodder crops, but does not include
    aquaculture. ([agriculture]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[fire point]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[fire point]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the lowest temperature at
    which a substance will ignite and will continue to burn for at least
    5 seconds. ([point d'inflammation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[flash point]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[flash point]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the lowest temperature at
    which the application of an ignition source causes the vapours of a
    liquid to ignite near the surface of the liquid or within a test
    vessel. ([point d'éclair]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[fuel cell]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[fuel cell]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an electrochemical device
    that converts the chemical energy of a fuel to electrical energy,
    heat and reaction products. ([pile à combustible]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[fuel cell cartridge]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[fuel cell cartridge]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an article that
    stores fuel for discharge into a fuel cell through one or more
    valves that control the discharge of the fuel into the fuel
    cell. ([cartouche pour pile à combustible]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[fuel cell engine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[fuel cell engine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a device that is used
    to power equipment and that consists of a fuel cell and its fuel
    supply, whether integrated with or separate from the fuel cell, and
    includes all appurtenances necessary to fulfil its
    function. ([moteur pile à combustible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a substance that at 50°C has a
    vapour pressure greater than 300 kPa or that is completely gaseous
    at 20°C at an absolute pressure of 101.3 kPa and that is

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} compressed (other than in solution) so that when
      it is packaged under pressure for transport it remains entirely
      gaseous at 20°C;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} liquefied so that when it is packaged for
      transport it is partially liquid at 20°C;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} refrigerated so that when it is packaged for
      transport it is made partially liquid because of its low
      temperature; or

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in solution so that when it is packaged for
      transport it is dissolved in a solvent. ([gaz]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[gross mass]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[gross mass]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for a means of containment, the mass of the means
      of containment and all of its contents; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for a quantity of dangerous goods, the gross mass
      of all minimum required means of containment used to contain the
      dangerous goods. ([masse brute]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[import]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[import]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2023-155, s.
    4\]]{.Repealed}

[[infectious substance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[infectious substance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a substance known
    or reasonably believed to contain viable micro-organisms such as
    bacteria, viruses, rickettsia, parasites, fungi and other agents
    such as prions that are known or reasonably believed to cause
    disease in humans or animals and that are listed in Appendix 3 to
    Part 2 (Classification) or that exhibit characteristics similar to a
    substance listed in Appendix 3. ([matière
    infectieuse]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[inland voyage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[inland voyage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in
    section 1 of the [Vessel Safety Certificates
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2021-135). ([voyage en eaux
    internes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[in standard]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[in standard]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means that a means of
    containment meets the requirements set out in section 5.2 of Part 5
    (Means of Containment). ([en règle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[in transport]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[in transport]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means that a person has
    possession of dangerous goods for the purposes of transportation or
    for the purposes of storing them in the course of
    transportation. ([en transport]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[large means of containment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[large means of containment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a means of
    containment with a capacity greater than 450 L. ([grand
    contenant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[LC~50~]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[LC~50~]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the lowest concentration of
    gas, vapour, mist or dust that, when administered by continuous
    inhalation to both male and female young adult albino rats for one
    hour, results in the death within 14 days of one half of the
    animals. ([CL~50~]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[LD~50~ (dermal)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[LD~50~ (dermal)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the lowest amount of a
    substance that, when administered by continuous contact with the
    bare skin of both male and female young adult albino rabbits for 24
    hours, results in the death within 14 days of one half of the
    animals. ([DL~50~ (absorption cutanée)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[LD~50~ (oral)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[LD~50~ (oral)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the lowest amount of a
    substance that, when administered by mouth to both male and female
    young adult albino rats, results in the death within 14 days of one
    half of the animals. ([DL~50~ (ingestion)]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[liquid]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[liquid]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a substance that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a melting point less than or equal to 20°C at
      an absolute pressure of 101.3 kPa; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is a viscous substance for which a specific
      melting point cannot be determined but that is determined to be a
      liquid in accordance with ASTM D 4359. ([liquide]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[lithium content]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[lithium content]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the mass of lithium in
    the anode of a lithium metal or lithium alloy cell. ([quantité de
    lithium]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[mist]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[mist]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a mixture of liquid particles and
    air in which 90% or more of the liquid particles have a diameter not
    greater than 10 µm. ([brouillard]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[net explosives quantity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[net explosives quantity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the net mass
    of explosives, excluding the mass of any means of
    containment. ([quantité nette d'explosifs]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[neutron radiation detector]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[neutron radiation detector]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a device
    that detects neutron radiation and includes a device in which a gas
    may be contained in a hermetically sealed electron tube transducer
    that converts neutron radiation into a measureable electric
    signal. ([détecteur de rayonnement neutronique]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[offer for transport]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[offer for transport]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, for dangerous
    goods not in transport, to select or allow the selection of a
    carrier to transport the dangerous goods, to prepare or allow the
    preparation of the dangerous goods so that a carrier can take
    possession of them for transport or to allow a carrier to take
    possession of the dangerous goods for transport. ([demande de
    transport]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[overpack]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[overpack]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an enclosure that is used by
    a single consignor to consolidate one or more small means of
    containment for ease of handling but that is not a minimum required
    means of containment. This definition does not include a large means
    of containment or a unit load device, as defined in the ICAO
    Technical Instructions, that is intended for transport by
    aircraft. ([suremballage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[packing group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[packing group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a group in which
    dangerous goods are included based on the inherent danger of the
    dangerous goods; Packing Group I indicates great danger, Packing
    Group II indicates medium danger and Packing Group III indicates
    minor danger. ([groupe d'emballage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[passenger]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[passenger]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for a vessel, a passenger within the meaning of
      section 2 of the [Canada Shipping Act, 2001](/eng/acts/C-10.15);
      and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for a road vehicle, a railway vehicle or an
      aircraft, a person carried on board the means of transport but
      does not include

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a crew member,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a person who is accompanying dangerous goods
        or other cargo,

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an operator, owner or charterer of the means
        of transport,

      - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} an employee of the operator, owner or
        charterer of the means of transport, who is acting in the course
        of employment, or

      - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a person carrying out inspection or
        investigation duties under an Act of Parliament or of a
        provincial legislature. ([passager]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[passenger carrying aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[passenger carrying aircraft]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
    aircraft that is carrying one or more passengers. ([aéronef de
    passagers]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[passenger carrying railway vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[passenger carrying railway vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    railway vehicle that is carrying one or more passengers. ([véhicule
    ferroviaire de passagers]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[passenger carrying road vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[passenger carrying road vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a road
    vehicle that is carrying one or more passengers. ([véhicule routier
    de passagers]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[passenger carrying vessel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[passenger carrying vessel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a vessel
    that is carrying one or more passengers. ([bâtiment à
    passagers]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[permit for equivalent level of safety]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[permit for equivalent level of
    safety]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2023-155, s.
    4\]]{.Repealed}

[[primary class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[primary class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the first class shown in
    column 3 of Schedule 1. ([classe primaire]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[protective direction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[protective direction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a direction
    issued under section 32 of the Act to cease an activity or to
    conduct other activities to reduce any danger to public
    safety. ([ordre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[radiation detection system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[radiation detection system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
    apparatus that contains a radiation detector as a
    component. ([système de détection des rayonnements]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[railway vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[railway vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any vehicle that is
    designed to be drawn or propelled on rails by any power other than
    muscle power and that is being prepared for use or being used on
    rails. ([véhicule ferroviaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[residue]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[residue]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the dangerous goods remaining
    in a means of containment after its contents have been emptied to
    the maximum extent feasible and before the means of containment is
    either refilled or cleaned of dangerous goods and purged to remove
    any vapours. ([résidu]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[road vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[road vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any vehicle that is
    designed to be drawn or propelled on land, including on ice roads,
    by any power other than muscle power and includes a machine designed
    to derive support in the atmosphere from reactions against the
    earth's surface of air expelled from the machine, but does not
    include a railway vehicle that operates exclusively on
    rails. ([véhicule routier]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ro-ro ship]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ro-ro ship]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in
    section 1.2.1 of the IMDG Code. ([navire roulier]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[safety mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[safety mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2023-155, s.
    4\]]{.Repealed}

[[sheltered waters voyage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[sheltered waters voyage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning
    as in section 1 of the [Vessel Safety Certificates
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2021-135). ([voyage en eaux
    abritées]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[shipping document]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[shipping document]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a document that
    relates to dangerous goods that are being offered for transport,
    handled or transported and that contains the information required by
    Part 3 relating to the goods but does not include an electronic
    record. ([document d'expédition]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[shipping name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[shipping name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an entry in upper case
    letters (capitals) in column 2 of Schedule 1, but does not include
    any lower case descriptive text except for the purpose of
    determining the classification of dangerous goods. ([appellation
    réglementaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[small means of containment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[small means of containment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a means of
    containment with a capacity less than or equal to 450 L. ([petit
    contenant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[solid]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[solid]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a substance that is not a liquid
    or a gas. ([solide]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[special provision]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[special provision]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an item of
    Schedule 2 referred to in column 5 of Schedule 1. ([disposition
    particulière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[standardized means of containment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[standardized means of
    containment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2023-155, s.
    4\]]{.Repealed}

[[subsidiary class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[subsidiary class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a class shown in
    parentheses in column 3 of Schedule 1. ([classe
    subsidiaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[substance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[substance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes an
    article. ([matière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[technical name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[technical name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the chemical name or
    another name currently used in a scientific or technical handbook,
    journal or text but does not include a trade name. ([appellation
    technique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[train]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[train]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a train, as defined in the Canadian Rail
      Operating Rules, published by The Railway Association of Canada
      and approved by the Minister under the [Railway Safety
      Act](/eng/acts/R-4.2) on January 16, 1990, as amended to July 1,
      2000; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a number of railway vehicles coupled together
      moving at a velocity exceeding 24 km/h (15 mph) with at least one
      railway vehicle providing propulsion and at least one railway
      vehicle containing dangerous goods for which a placard is required
      to be displayed in accordance with Part
      4. ([train]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[transport index]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[transport index]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as
    determined under the [Packaging and Transport of Nuclear Substances
    Regulations, 2015](/eng/regulations/SOR-2015-145). ([indice de
    transport]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[tube]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[tube]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a large means of containment that
    is cylindrical in shape and that is capable of withstanding an
    internal absolute pressure of 12.4 MPa. ([tube]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[Type P620 means of containment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Type P620 means of containment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a means
    of containment that is in compliance with the requirements of
    CGSB-43.125 for Type P620 packaging or, if it is manufactured
    outside Canada, is in compliance with the requirements of Chapter
    6.3 and Packing Instruction P620 of the UN Recommendations and the
    national regulations of the country of manufacture. ([contenant de
    type P620]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Type P650 means of containment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Type P650 means of containment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a means
    of containment that is in compliance with the requirements of
    CGSB-43.125 for Type P650 packaging or, if it is manufactured
    outside Canada, is in compliance with the requirements of Packing
    Instruction P650 of the UN Recommendations and the national
    regulations of the country of manufacture. ([contenant de type
    P650]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[UN number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[UN number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an entry in column 1 of
    Schedule 1. ([numéro UN]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[UN standardized means of containment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[UN standardized means of containment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    means of containment that meets the requirements set out in section
    5.6 of Part 5 (Means of Containment). ([contenant normalisé
    UN]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[vapour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[vapour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the dispersion in air of
    imperceptible particles of a substance that is liquid or solid in
    its normal state. ([vapeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[watt-hour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[watt-hour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[Wh]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} the
    electrical energy developed by a power of 1 watt (W) during 1
    hour (h) and expressed as watt-hour
    (Wh). ([wattheure]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
    [Wh]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

### [General Provisions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1227593 .Subheading}

#### [Applicability of the Regulations]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227594 .Subheading}

**[[1.5]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.5 .sectionLabel}** Unless otherwise stated
in sections 1.15 to 1.48 of this Part or in Schedule 1 or 2, dangerous
goods must be handled, offered for transport or transported in
accordance with these Regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2008-34, ss. 5, 6
:::

#### [Schedule 2: Special Provisions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227598 .Subheading}

- **[[1.5.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.5.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} When there is a special provision in
  Schedule 2 for dangerous goods, that special provision applies.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} When there is a conflict between a special provision
  in Schedule 2 and other provisions in these Regulations, the special
  provision applies.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The UN numbers set out in italics after a special
  provision of Schedule 2 indicate the dangerous goods in respect of
  which the special provision applies. They are for information only and
  are not part of the Regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2008-34, s. 6
- SOR/2020-23, s. 2
:::

#### [Schedules 1 and 3: Forbidden Dangerous Goods]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227605 .Subheading}

- **[[1.5.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.5.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} When the word "Forbidden" is shown
  for dangerous goods in column 3 of Schedule 1 or column 2 of Schedule
  3, a person must not handle, offer for transport or transport the
  dangerous goods.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} When the word "Forbidden" is shown for dangerous
  goods in column 8 or 9 of Schedule 1, a person must not offer for
  transport or transport the dangerous goods by the means of transport
  set out in the heading of that column.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2008-34, s. 6
- SOR/2014-306, s. 4
:::

#### [Schedule 1: Quantity Limits in Columns 8 and 9]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227611 .Subheading}

- **[[1.6]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.6 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} When
  there is a number shown in column 8 of Schedule 1, that number is a
  quantity limit per means of containment for the corresponding
  dangerous goods in column 2. A person must not load onto a passenger
  carrying vessel, or transport on a road vehicle or a railway vehicle
  on board a passenger carrying vessel, dangerous goods that exceed the
  quantity limit. Dangerous goods exceed the quantity limit if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a solid, they have a mass that is
    greater than the number when that number is expressed in kilograms;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a liquid, they have a volume that is
    greater than the number when that number is expressed in litres;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a gas, including a gas in a
    liquefied form, they are contained in a means of containment the
    capacity of which is greater than the number when that number is
    expressed in litres; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an explosive

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} not subject to special provision 85 or 86, they
      have a net explosives quantity that is greater than the number
      when that number is expressed in kilograms, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} subject to special provision 85 or 86, they
      exceed 100 articles.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} When there is a number shown in column 9 of Schedule
  1, that number is a quantity limit per means of containment for the
  corresponding dangerous goods in column 2. A person must not offer for
  transport or transport by passenger carrying road vehicle or passenger
  carrying railway vehicle dangerous goods that exceed the quantity
  limit. Dangerous goods exceed the quantity limit if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a solid, they have a mass that is
    greater than the number when that number is expressed in kilograms;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a liquid, they have a volume that is
    greater than the number when that number is expressed in litres;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a gas, including a gas in a
    liquefied form, they are contained in a means of containment the
    capacity of which is greater than the number when that number is
    expressed in litres; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an explosive

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} not subject to special provision 85 or 86, they
      have a net explosives quantity that is greater than the number
      when that number is expressed in kilograms, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} subject to special provision 85 or 86, they
      exceed 100 articles.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a quantity limit in column 8 or 9 of Schedule 1
  conflicts with any other quantity limit in these Regulations, other
  than a quantity limit in special provisions, the quantity limit in
  that column takes precedence.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2008-34, s. 6
- SOR/2014-306, s. 5
- SOR/2016-95, s. 4
- SOR/2017-253, s. 53
:::

#### [Safety Requirements, Documents and Safety Marks]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227630 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2023-155, s. 5

\]
:::

**[[1.7]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.7 .sectionLabel}** As provided for in
section 5 of the Act, a person must not import, offer for transport,
handle or transport dangerous goods unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person complies with all applicable prescribed
  safety requirements;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the dangerous goods are accompanied by all applicable
  prescribed documents; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the means of containment and transport comply with
  all applicable prescribed safety standards and display all applicable
  prescribed safety marks.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-155, s. 6](#1407920-1418167){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1407920-1418167.html"
  role="button"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-1.7-20200219.html "Link to previous version of section 1.7"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Prohibition: Explosives]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227635 .Subheading}

**[[1.8]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.8 .sectionLabel}** A person must not
handle, offer for transport or transport dangerous goods by any means of
transport if the dangerous goods are explosives and

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} are in direct contact with a large means of
  containment, except when the explosives are to be transported by road
  vehicle in quantities that are allowed for explosives in section 9.5,
  Part 9 (Road), in Schedule 1 or in any special provision in
  Schedule 2; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} are also radioactive materials.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-245, s. 5
:::

**[[1.9]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.9 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/2017-137, s. 6\]]{.Repealed}

#### [Requirements Respecting the Transportation of Dangerous Goods on Board Passenger Carrying Vessels]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227642 .Subheading}

- **[[1.10]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.10
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The requirements of these
  Regulations respecting the transportation of dangerous goods other
  than explosives on board a passenger carrying vessel apply to a
  passenger carrying vessel that is transporting more than 25 passengers
  or more than one passenger for each 3 m of the length of the vessel.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The requirements of these Regulations respecting the
  transportation of dangerous goods that are explosives on board a
  passenger carrying vessel apply to a passenger carrying vessel that is
  transporting more than 12 passengers.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2014-152, s. 5
- SOR/2017-253, s. 4
:::

#### [Use of 49 CFR for Non-Regulated Dangerous Goods]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227648 .Subheading}

**[[1.11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.11 .sectionLabel}** When a substance is
regulated in the United States by 49 CFR but is not regulated in Canada
by these Regulations, a person may transport the substance between
Canada and the United States by road vehicle or railway vehicle in
accordance with all or part of 49 CFR.

**[[1.12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.12 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/2023-155, s. 7\]]{.Repealed}

[Previous
Version](section-1.12-20200219.html "Link to previous version of section 1.12"){.PITLink}
:::

SOR/2023-155, s. 7\]]{.Repealed}

### [Special Cases]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1227655 .Subheading}

#### [150 kg Gross Mass Exemption]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227656 .Subheading}

- **[[1.15]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.15
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Part 3 (Documentation), Part 4
  (Dangerous Goods Safety Marks), Part 5 (Means of Containment), Part 6
  (Training) and Part 8 (Reporting Requirements) do not apply to the
  handling, offering for transport or transporting of dangerous goods on
  a road vehicle, a railway vehicle or a vessel on a domestic voyage if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} dangerous goods included in Class 2, Gases, they
      are in one or more small means of containment in compliance with
      the requirements for transporting gases in Part 5 (Means of
      Containment), except that, in the case of dangerous goods that are
      UN1950, AEROSOLS, or UN2037, GAS CARTRIDGES, the requirement in
      section 8.1.7 of CGSB-43.123 that aerosol containers and gas
      cartridges be tightly packed in a strong outer packaging does not
      apply, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} dangerous goods not included in Class 2, they
      are in one or more small means of containment designed,
      constructed, filled, closed, secured and maintained so that under
      normal conditions of transport, including handling, there will be
      no release of the dangerous goods that could endanger public
      safety;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} except for dangerous goods included in Class 2,
    Gases, the dangerous goods are contained in one or more means of
    containment each of which has a gross mass less than or equal to
    30 kg;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the gross mass of all dangerous goods

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} transported on the road vehicle or the railway
      vehicle is less than or equal to 150 kg, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} transported on the vessel on a domestic voyage
      is less than or equal to 150 kg, excluding dangerous goods in a
      road vehicle or railway vehicle being transported on the vessel;
      and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the dangerous goods are in a quantity or
    concentration available to the general public and are transported

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} by a user or purchaser of the dangerous goods, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} by a retailer to or from a user or purchaser of
      the dangerous goods.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to dangerous goods that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} are in a quantity or concentration that requires an
    ERAP;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} require a control or emergency temperature;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 1, Explosives, except for UN
    numbers UN0012, UN0014, UN0044, UN0055, UN0105, UN0131, UN0161,
    UN0173, UN0186, UN0191, UN0197, UN0276, UN0312, UN0323, UN0335 if
    classified as a consumer firework, UN0336, UN0337, UN0351, UN0373,
    UN0378, UN0404, UN0405, UN0431, UN0432, UN0454, UN0499, UN0501,
    UN0503, UN0505 to UN0507, UN0509 and UN0510;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 2.1, Flammable Gases, and are
    in a cylinder with a capacity greater than 46 L;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 2.3, Toxic Gases;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 4, Flammable Solids;
    Substances Liable to Spontaneous Combustion; Substances that on
    Contact with Water Emit Flammable Gases (Water-reactive Substances);
    and in Packing Group I;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 5.2, Organic Peroxides,
    unless they are allowed to be transported as limited quantities in
    accordance with section 1.17 and column 6(a) of Schedule 1;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} are liquids included in Class 6.1, Toxic
    Substances, and Packing Group I;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 6.2, Infectious Substances;
    or

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 7, Radioactive Materials, and
    are required to be licensed by the Canadian Nuclear Safety
    Commission.

#### [500 kg Gross Mass Exemption]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227682 .Subheading}

- **[[1.16]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.16
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Part 3 (Documentation), Part 4
  (Dangerous Goods Safety Marks) and Part 5 (Means of Containment) do
  not apply to the handling, offering for transport or transporting of
  dangerous goods on a road vehicle, a railway vehicle or a vessel on a
  domestic voyage if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} dangerous goods included in Class 2, Gases, they
      are in one or more small means of containment in compliance with
      the requirements for transporting gases in Part 5 (Means of
      Containment), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} dangerous goods not included in Class 2, Gases,
      they are in one or more means of containment

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} each of which has a gross mass less than or
        equal to 30 kg and that is designed, constructed, filled,
        closed, secured and maintained so that under normal conditions
        of transport, including handling, there will be no accidental
        release of the dangerous goods that could endanger public
        safety, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} that are drums in compliance with the
        requirements of section 5.12 of Part 5 (Means of Containment),
        for transporting dangerous goods in drums;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the gross mass of all dangerous goods

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} transported on the road vehicle or the railway
      vehicle is less than or equal to 500 kg, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} transported on the vessel on a domestic voyage
      is less than or equal to 500 kg, excluding the dangerous goods in
      a road vehicle or railway vehicle being transported on the vessel;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} each means of containment has displayed on one
    side, other than a side on which it is intended to rest or to be
    stacked during transport,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the dangerous goods safety marks required by Part
      4 (Dangerous Goods Safety Marks), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} for dangerous goods, other than dangerous goods
      included in Class 2, Gases, the shipping name of the dangerous
      goods and the marks required for them in one of the following Acts
      and regulations, as long as those marks are legible and visible
      during handling and transporting in the same manner as dangerous
      goods safety marks:

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the [Pest Control Products
        Act](/eng/acts/P-9.01) and its regulations,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the [Hazardous Products Act](/eng/acts/H-3) and
        its regulations, or

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} the [Canada Consumer Product Safety
        Act](/eng/acts/C-1.68) and its regulations;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the dangerous goods are accompanied by a shipping
    document or document that is located, for a road or railway vehicle
    or a vessel, in accordance with the requirements for location of a
    shipping document in sections 3.7 to 3.9 of Part 3 (Documentation);
    and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any document referred to in paragraph (d), other
    than a shipping document, includes the following information in the
    following order:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the primary class of the dangerous goods,
      following the word "Class" or "Classe", and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the total number of means of containment, on
      which a dangerous goods safety mark is required to be displayed,
      for each primary class, following the words "number of means of
      containment" or "[nombre de contenants]{.otherLang lang="fr"}".

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to dangerous goods that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} are in a quantity or concentration that requires an
    ERAP;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} require a control or emergency temperature;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 1, Explosives, except for

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} explosives included in Class 1.4S, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} UN numbers UN0191, UN0197, UN0276, UN0312,
      UN0336, UN0403, UN0431, UN0453 and UN0493;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 2.1, Flammable Gases, and are
    in a cylinder with a capacity greater than 46 L;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 2.3, Toxic Gases;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 4, Flammable Solids;
    Substances Liable to Spontaneous Combustion; Substances that on
    Contact with Water Emit Flammable Gases (Water-reactive Substances);
    and in Packing Group I;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 5.2, Organic Peroxides,
    unless they are allowed to be transported as limited quantities in
    accordance with section 1.17 and column 6(a) of Schedule 1;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} are liquids included in Class 6.1, Toxic
    Substances, and Packing Group I;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 6.2, Infectious Substances;
    or

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} are included in Class 7, Radioactive Materials, and
    are required to be licensed by the Canadian Nuclear Safety
    Commission.

#### [Limited Quantities Exemption]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227717 .Subheading}

- **[[1.17]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.17 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  quantity of dangerous goods, other than explosives, is a limited
  quantity if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the dangerous goods are in one or more means of
    containment designed, constructed, filled, closed, secured and
    maintained so that under normal conditions of transport, including
    handling, there will be no accidental release of the dangerous goods
    that could endanger public safety; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} each outer means of containment has a gross mass
    that is less than or equal to 30 kg and

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the dangerous goods are a solid or a liquid,
      the goods in each inner means of containment are in a quantity
      that is less than or equal to the number shown in column 6(a) of
      Schedule 1, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if the dangerous goods are a gas, including a
      gas in a liquefied form, each means of containment in which they
      are contained has a capacity less than or equal to the number
      shown in column 6(a) of Schedule 1.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Part 3 (Documentation), Part 4 (Dangerous Goods
  Safety Marks), Part 5 (Means of Containment), Part 6 (Training), Part
  7 (Emergency Response Assistance Plan) and Part 8 (Reporting
  Requirements) do not apply to the handling, offering for transport or
  transporting of limited quantities of dangerous goods on a road
  vehicle, a railway vehicle or a vessel on a domestic voyage if each
  means of containment is legibly and durably marked on one side, other
  than a side on which it is intended to rest or to be stacked during
  transport, with the mark illustrated in subsection (5).

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} When a limited quantity of dangerous goods is in a
  means of containment that is inside another means of containment, the
  inner means of containment is not required to be marked if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the gross mass of the outer means of containment is
    less than or equal to 30 kg;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the outer means of containment is not intended to
    be opened during transport; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the outer means of containment is legibly and
    visibly marked, on a contrasting background, with the mark
    illustrated in subsection (5).

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} When a limited quantity of dangerous goods is in a
  means of containment that is inside an overpack, the following
  information must be displayed on the overpack unless the marks on the
  small means of containment are visible through the overpack:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the word "Overpack" or "[Suremballage]{.otherLang
    lang="fr"}" or ; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the mark illustrated in subsection (5), legibly and
    visibly marked on a contrasting background.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The mark is a square on point, and the line forming
  the square on point must be at least 2 mm wide. The top and bottom
  portions must be black and the central portion must be white or a
  contrasting colour. Each side of the mark must be at least 100 mm
  long. The letter "Y" may be displayed in the centre of the mark if the
  limited quantity is in compliance with the ICAO Technical
  Instructions. If the size of the means of containment so requires, the
  length of each side may be reduced to not less than 50 mm, provided
  that the mark remains clearly visible.

  +-----------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  | <figure>                                                              | <figure>                                                                                                     |
  | <div class="imageGroupcenter">                                        | <div class="imageGroupcenter">                                                                               |
  | <img src="/images/SOR-2001-286img/SOR-2001-286_ef001.jpg"             | <img src="/images/SOR-2001-286img/SOR-2001-286_ef002.png"                                                    |
  | alt="Black square on point with a white centered horizontal band." /> | alt="Black square on point, with the black capitalized letter “Y” over a white centered horizontal band." /> |
  | </div>                                                                | </div>                                                                                                       |
  | </figure>                                                             | </figure>                                                                                                    |
  +-----------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Until December 31, 2020, instead of being marked with
  the mark illustrated in subsection (5), a means of containment may
  have displayed on it

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the words "Limited Quantity" or "[quantité
    limitée]{.otherLang lang="fr"}";

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the abbreviation "Ltd. Qty." or "[quant.
    ltée]{.otherLang lang="fr"}";

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the words "Consumer Commodity" or "[bien de
    consommation]{.otherLang lang="fr"}"; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the UN number of each limited quantity of dangerous
    goods placed within a square on point.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph (6)(d), the line
  forming the square on point must be black and be at least 2 mm wide.
  If the dangerous goods have different UN numbers, the square on point
  must be large enough to include each UN number, but in any case each
  side must be not less than 50 mm long. The UN numbers must be at least
  6 mm high. The line and UN numbers must be on a contrasting
  background.

#### [Excepted Quantities Exemption]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227746 .Subheading}

- **[[1.17.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.17.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A quantity of dangerous goods, other
  than explosives, is an excepted quantity if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the dangerous goods are in an inner means of
    containment and an outer means of containment that are designed,
    constructed, filled, closed, secured and maintained so that under
    normal conditions of transport, including handling, there will be no
    accidental release of the dangerous goods that could endanger public
    safety;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any of the dangerous goods in the inner means of
    containment,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if solids, have a mass that is less than or equal
      to the number shown in column 1 of the table to subsection (2) for
      the corresponding alphanumeric code in column 6(b) of Schedule 1,
      when that number is expressed in grams,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if liquids, have a volume that is less than or
      equal to the number shown in column 1 of the table to
      subsection (2) for the corresponding alphanumeric code in column
      6(b) of Schedule 1, when that number is expressed in millilitres,
      or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} if gases, including a gas in a liquefied form,
      are contained in one or more means of containment each of which
      has a capacity less than or equal to the number shown in column 1
      of the table to subsection (2) for the corresponding alphanumeric
      code in column 6(b) of Schedule 1, when that number is expressed
      in millilitres; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any of the dangerous goods in the outer means of
    containment,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if solids, have a mass that is less than or equal
      to the number shown in column 2 of the table to subsection (2) for
      the corresponding alphanumeric code in column 6(b) of Schedule 1,
      when that number is expressed in grams,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if liquids, have a volume that is less than or
      equal to the number shown in column 2 of the table to
      subsection (2) for the corresponding alphanumeric code in column
      6(b) of Schedule 1, when that number is expressed in millilitres,
      or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} if gases, including a gas in a liquefied form,
      are contained in one or more means of containment each of which
      has a capacity less than or equal to the number shown in column 2
      of the table to subsection (2) for the corresponding alphanumeric
      code in column 6(b) of Schedule 1, when that number is expressed
      in millilitres.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} When dangerous goods in excepted quantities for which
  different alphanumeric codes are assigned are together in an outer
  means of containment, the total quantity of dangerous goods must not
  exceed the lowest maximum net quantity per outer means of containment
  that is set out in column 2 of the table to this subsection for any of
  the dangerous goods.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Parts 3 to 8 and 17 do not apply to the offering for
  transport, handling or transporting of dangerous goods in excepted
  quantities if each means of containment is marked on one side, other
  than a side on which it is intended to rest or to be stacked during
  transport, with the excepted quantities mark illustrated below.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} When dangerous goods in excepted quantities are in a
  means of containment that is inside an overpack, the following
  information must be displayed on the overpack, unless that information
  is on the means of containment and is visible through the overpack:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the word "Overpack" or "[Suremballage]{.otherLang
    lang="fr"}"; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the mark illustrated in subsection (3).

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The number of outer means of containment containing
  dangerous goods in excepted quantities on a road vehicle, a railway
  vehicle or an intermodal container must not exceed 1 000.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} When dangerous goods in excepted quantities are in an
  inner means of containment that is inside an outer means of
  containment, the inner means of containment is not required to be
  marked in accordance with subsection (3) if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the outer means of containment is not intended to
    be opened during transport; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the outer means of containment is marked, legibly
    and visibly on a contrasting background, with the mark illustrated
    in that subsection.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} If a shipping document or any other document
  accompanies dangerous goods in excepted quantities, the document must
  include the words "dangerous goods in excepted quantities" or
  "[marchandises dangereuses en quantités exceptées]{.otherLang
  lang="fr"}" and must indicate the number of outer means of
  containment.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} These Regulations, except for Parts 1 and 2, do not
  apply to the offering for transport, handling or transport of
  dangerous goods in excepted quantities that are assigned to
  alphanumeric codes E1, E2, E4 and E5 in column 6(b) of Schedule 1 if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the net quantity of the dangerous goods per inner
    means of containment is less than or equal to 1 g for solids or 1 mL
    for liquids and gases; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the net quantity of the dangerous goods per outer
    means of containment is less than or equal to 100 g for solids or
    100 mL for liquids and gases.

#### [Medical Device or Article]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227784 .Subheading}

**[[1.18]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.18 .sectionLabel}** These Regulations do
not apply to the transport on a road vehicle, a railway vehicle or a
vessel on a domestic voyage of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a medical device, wheelchair or medical article if

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the medical device is attached to or implanted in
    an individual or an animal, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the wheelchair or medical article is in transport
    and is intended for the personal use of a specific individual;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a radio-pharmaceutical that has been injected in or
  ingested by an individual or an animal.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2002-306, s. 7
- SOR/2008-34, s. 9
- SOR/2012-245, s. 9
- SOR/2017-253, s. 52
:::

#### [Samples for Inspection or Investigation Exemption]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227792 .Subheading}

**[[1.19]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.19 .sectionLabel}** These Regulations do
not apply to samples of goods, including forensic samples, that are
reasonably believed to be dangerous goods if, for the purposes of
inspection or investigation duties under an Act of Parliament or of a
provincial legislature, the samples are

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in transport under the direct supervision of a
  federal, provincial or municipal government employee acting in the
  course of employment; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in one or more means of containment designed,
  constructed, filled, closed, secured and maintained so that under
  normal conditions of transport, including handling, there will be no
  release of the dangerous goods that could endanger public safety.

::: HistoricalNote

#### [Samples Classifying, Analysing or Testing Exemption]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227798 .Subheading}

**[[1.19.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.19.1 .sectionLabel}** Parts 2 to 7 and
17 do not apply to samples of goods that the consignor reasonably
believes to be dangerous goods whose classification or exact chemical
composition is unknown and cannot be readily determined if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} samples that are reasonably believed to be a gas,
    including a gas in a liquefied form, they are in one or more means
    of containment in compliance with the requirements for transporting
    gases in Part 5 (Means of Containment), or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} samples that are reasonably believed not to be a
    gas, they are in one or more means of containment designed,
    constructed, filled, closed, secured and maintained so that under
    normal conditions of transport, including handling, there will be no
    release of the dangerous goods that could endanger public safety;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the samples are in transport for the purposes of
  classifying, analysing or testing;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the samples are believed not to contain explosives,
  infectious substances or radioactive materials;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the dangerous goods are contained in one or more
  means of containment each of which has a gross mass less than or equal
  to 10 kg;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the samples are accompanied by a document that
  includes the name and address of the consignor and the words "test
  samples" or "[échantillons d'épreuve]{.otherLang lang="fr"}"; and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} each means of containment has marked on it the words
  "test samples" or "[échantillons d'épreuve]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" and
  the words are legible and displayed on a contrasting background.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2008-34, s. 10

#### [Samples Demonstration Exemption]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227810 .Subheading}

**[[1.19.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.19.2 .sectionLabel}** Parts 3, 4 and 17
do not apply to samples of dangerous goods if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} samples included in Class 2, Gases, they are in one
    or more means of containment in compliance with the requirements for
    transporting gases in Part 5 (Means of Containment), or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} samples not included in Class 2, they are in one
    or more means of containment designed, constructed, filled, closed,
    secured and maintained so that under normal conditions of transport,
    including handling, there will be no release of the dangerous goods
    that could endanger public safety;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the samples are in transport for demonstration
  purposes;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the samples are in the custody of an agent of the
  manufacturer or distributor who is acting in the course of employment;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the samples are not for sale;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the samples are not transported in a passenger
  carrying road vehicle, passenger carrying railway vehicle, passenger
  carrying aircraft or passenger carrying vessel other than a passenger
  carrying vessel that operates over the most direct water route between
  two points that are not more than 5 km apart;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the dangerous goods are contained in one or more
  means of containment each of which has a gross mass less than or equal
  to 10 kg; and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} each means of containment has marked on it the words
  "demonstration samples" or "[échantillons de démonstration]{.otherLang
  lang="fr"}" and the words are legible and displayed on a contrasting
  background.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2008-34, s. 10

#### [National Defence]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227823 .Subheading}

**[[1.20]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.20 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
paragraph 3(4)(a) of the Act, any activity or thing related to the
transportation of dangerous goods is under the sole direction or control
of the Minister of National Defence if the dangerous goods are in or on
a means of transport

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} owned and operated by the Department of National
  Defence or operated on behalf of the Department of National Defence by

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an employee of the Department of National Defence,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a member of the Canadian Forces, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} civilian personnel who are not employed by the
    Department of National Defence if the means of transport is
    accompanied at all times by, and is under the direct responsibility
    of, an employee of the Department of National Defence or a member of
    the Canadian Forces;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} owned and operated by the military establishment of a
  member country of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization or operated
  on behalf of such an establishment by

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} military or civilian personnel of that
    establishment, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} civilian personnel who are not employed by that
    establishment if the means of transport is accompanied at all times
    by, and is under the direct responsibility of, military or civilian
    personnel of that establishment; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} owned and operated by the military establishment of
  another country under an agreement with the Department of National
  Defence or operated on behalf of such an establishment by

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} military or civilian personnel of that
    establishment, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} civilian personnel who are not employed by that
    establishment if the means of transport is accompanied at all times
    by, and is under the direct responsibility of, military or civilian
    personnel of that establishment.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-273, s. 3
:::

#### [Agriculture: 1 500 kg Gross Mass Farm Vehicle Exemption]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1227837 .Subheading}

- **[[1.21]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.21
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Part 3 (Documentation), Part 4
  (Dangerous Goods Safety Marks), Part 5 (Means of Containment) and Part
  6 (Training) do not apply to the handling, offering for transport or
  transporting of dangerous goods on a road vehicle licensed as a farm
  vehicle if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} dangerous goods included in Class 2, Gases, they
      are in one or more means of containment in compliance with the
      requirements for transporting gases in Part 5 (Means of
      Containment), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} dangerous goods not included in Class 2, they
      are in one or more means of containment designed, constructed,
      filled, closed, secured and maintained so that under normal
      conditions of transport, including handling, there will be no
      release of the dangerous goods that could endanger public safety;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the gross mass of all dangerous goods on the road
    vehicle is less than or equal to 1 500 kg;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the dangerous goods are to be or have been used by
    a farmer for farming purposes;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the dangerous goods are transported solely on land
    and the distance on public roads is less than or equal to 100 km;
    and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the dangerous goods do not include

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} Class 1, Explosives, other than explosives
      included in Class 1.4S,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} Class 2.1, Flammable Gases, in a cylinder with a
      capacity greater than 46 L,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} Class 2.3, Toxic Gases,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} Class 6.2, Infectious Substances, or

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} Class 7, Radioactive Materials.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite the exemption from Part 3 (Documentation) in
  subsection (1), when an ERAP is required under Part 7 (Emergency
  Response Assistance Plan), the dangerous goods for which the plan is
  required must be accompanied by a shipping document.
